newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering confident for 1997 after strong Q1.
newsitem.headline: Schering confident for 1997 after strong Q1.

text.p: German pharmaceuticals group Schering AG said on Tuesday that it expected profit for the full 1997 year to grow by between 10 and 15 percent after strong growth in the first quarter of the year.

The company said its group net profit rose 16 percent to 152 million marks ($89.1 million) in the first three months of 1997 compared with 131 million a year earlier. Group sales rose to 1.465 billion marks from 1.206 billion marks.
In its interim statement, Schering said, "On the basis of improved currency relationships we expect sales to continue to develop favourably."
It added that positive influences would continue to affect the company's profits in the course of the year.
"We therefore expect profit growth of 10-15 percent for the full year," the report said.
Schering shares were trading 90 pfennigs lower at 170 marks in pre-bourse trade in spite of the positive report. Dealers said the results were in line with expectations.
